response_excerpt.summary: The top traffic sources ranked by total visits are: (1) Referral - 701,830 visits, (2) Social - 701,470 visits, (3) Ads - 700,850 visits, and (4) Organic - 700,230 visits. After joining orders and users tables on user_id, I analyzed order counts by user segment (VIP level and gender). Key findings: (1) Each VIP level (L1, L2, L3) has exactly 40 users and 1,710 orders, showing balanced distribution. (2) Male users consistently have higher orders per user (43.5 vs 42.0) and significantly higher average order values across all VIP levels. (3) L3 VIP users generate the highest total revenue (1,456,358.5) and highest average order value (851.67), followed by L1 (1,367,439.5) and L2 (1,364,718.0). (4) The most notable gap is in average order value by gender - male users average ~967-1,041 per order while females average ~623-697, indicating strong gender-based purchasing behavior differences regardless of VIP tier.

I analyzed traffic and orders across 6 months (Jul-Dec 2025), covering 60 products with 2,804,400 total page views and 1,658,841 unique visitors across 4 channels (ads, social, referral, organic). Key findings:

**Monthly Trends:** Traffic (PV & UV) peaked in September-October (~514K PV, ~305K UV) then declined into December. Revenue stayed relatively stable around ¥509K-¥548K/month. The UV-to-order conversion rate was highest in July (0.26%) and December (0.25%), and lowest in Sep-Oct (0.22%). Cart-to-order conversion followed a similar pattern, peaking at 2.27% (Jul) and 2.21% (Dec).

**Channel Performance:** Ads generated the highest revenue (¥969,919) and most orders (1,000), followed by social (¥817,104, 955 orders), referral (¥783,216, 1,000 orders), and organic (¥632,520, 955 orders). All channels had similar average bounce rates (~28.5%) and conversion rates (~0.23-0.24%).

**Top Products:** Product #56 led in revenue (¥129,913) and orders (80), followed by #60 (¥122,240) and #48 (¥110,565). Product #36 had the most page views (49,870) but moderate conversion.

**Overall:** The business sees consistent monthly revenue of ~¥520K-¥548K with low overall conversion (~0.23% UV-to-order), suggesting opportunities to improve funnel efficiency from traffic to purchase.

Joined the users and orders tables on user_id, then grouped by vip_level (user segment). There are 3 segments: L1, L2, L3 (where L3 is the highest tier). Each segment has exactly 40 users and 1,710 orders, but L3 stands out with the highest total revenue (¥1,456,358.50) and highest average order value (¥851.67), compared to L2 (¥1,364,718.00, ¥798.08) and L1 (¥1,367,439.50, ¥799.67).
